data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'asba', meaning 'to rise above' or 'to exalt'. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies being raised above the mundane and attaining a sublime spiritual state. The name Asba carries the meaning “Exalted, Sublime” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asba usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, sublime and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Asba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Sublime.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asba total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
